title: Vehicle Repair Inspection Checklist
subtitle: General Vehicle Repair: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Vehicle Repair Inspection Checklist covers vehicle system, reported symptom, diagnostic result, repair operation, part, and roadworthiness decision. The service advisor records General Vehicle Repair criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Vehicle Repair Inspection Checklist keeps General Vehicle Repair exceptions visible until the service advisor handoff.
use_case: Use Vehicle Repair Inspection Checklist at repair facility, service bay, test area, and customer handoff point. Document vehicle system, reported symptom, diagnostic result, repair operation, part, and roadworthiness decision identity before General Vehicle Repair begins. Compare vehicle system, reported symptom, diagnostic result, repair operation, part, and roadworthiness decision findings with stated General Vehicle Repair criteria; route unresolved General Vehicle Repair issues to qualified automotive repair reviewer. For Vehicle Repair Inspection Checklist, confirm requirements for General Vehicle Repair. Ask qualified automotive repair reviewer to review General Vehicle Repair conditions beyond the service advisor's role.

sections.title: Inspector, location, and subject identity
sections.guidance: For General Vehicle Repair, identify responsible parties, repair facility, service bay, test area, and customer handoff point, and the linked vehicle system, reported symptom, diagnostic result, repair operation, part, and roadworthiness decision source.

sections.title: Checklist points, conditions, and actions
sections.guidance: Capture General Vehicle Repair facts for vehicle system, reported symptom, diagnostic result, repair operation, part, and roadworthiness decision; include result, limit, source, and next control.

sections.title: Inspection exception, restriction, and reinspection
sections.guidance: Use observed General Vehicle Repair evidence to state disposition. Keep limits visible and give Service Advisor both correction and repeat-check responsibility.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Vehicle cannot be safely tested or released
blocks.guidance: Pause General Vehicle Repair when a safety-critical condition, uncertain diagnosis, authorization gap, or failed verification remains. Retain the available General Vehicle Repair proof and route unresolved vehicle system, reported symptom, diagnostic result, repair operation, part, and roadworthiness decision scope to service advisor.
